write verb

also writing, write out, write out the sentences, write a book, write Latin, write a program

classical

Traupman 32, 409

scrībō, scrībere, scrīpsī, scrīptum

verb, third conjugation · Conjugation on Wiktionary

Historically associated with scratching or incising. English script belongs to this family.

Other words

  • scrīptūra, scrīptūrae f. — writing, the act of writing

    noun, first declension · also used · classical · Cic. de Or. 1.150 (Lewis & Short); Traupman 32, 409 · Declension on Wiktionary

  • scrīptiō, scrīptiōnis f. — writing (the act)

    noun, third declension · also used · classical · Cic. Brut. 92 (see essay); Traupman 409 · Declension on Wiktionary

  • scrīptum, scrīptī n. — a piece of writing; in the plural, writings

    noun, second declension · also used · classical · Traupman 409 · Declension on Wiktionary

Examples

  • Sententiās perscrībe (perscrībite).

    Write out the sentences.Traupman 34

  • librum cōnscrībere

    to write a bookTraupman 409

  • programma compōnere

    to write a programTraupman 409

  • Latīnē scrībere

    to write LatinTraupman 409

See also scratch.
